SRC-357:R001.text: Measured Verification Baseline: Quantify the 8,548-test full core-unit family bottleneck (T-1975 4 distinct runs, 7,496.9s total).

SRC-357:R002.text: Reuse Existing Capabilities: Leverage existing verification_cache, single_flight, core_unit.reusable_record without duplicating runners.

SRC-357:R003.text: Evidence-Grade Telemetry: Capture structured wall-time profiling across request, discovery, execution, citation, and phase transitions.

SRC-357:R004.text: Explicit Full-Suite Triggers: Require auditable triggers (NEW_TESTED_SOURCE_BYTES, CHANGED_BASELINE, MANDATORY_FULL_ACCEPTANCE) for full-family runs.

SRC-357:R005.text: Tiered Verification Policy: Use DEV/LOCAL focused tests mid-edit and certified impact/full suites at mandatory SHIP boundaries.

SRC-357:R006.text: Stable Cohort Evidence Sharing: Reuse immutable verified full evidence across tickets sharing an identical final source generation.

SRC-357:R007.text: Red Result Flake Discipline: Diagnose verdict divergences, shard races, and test order-dependencies; prohibit retry-to-green looping.

SRC-357:R008.text: Performance Budgeting: Maintain 10-minute diagnostic thresholds without bypassing required safety gates.

SRC-357:R009.text: External Close-Ticket Owner: Classify Close-Ticket.ps1 as external host script outside SAIPEN repository boundaries.

SRC-357:R010.text: Canonical SHIP Gate Integrity: Guarantee that no ticket ships on stale, unverified, or incompatible evidence records.
